G-Shock GA-110

Analog-Digital · 51.2mm · 200m · quartz · 2010–2026

The G-Shock GA-110 is a family of large-cased, analog-digital watches known for a layered, complex dial design inspired by steampunk aesthetics. It is one of Casio's all-time best-selling G-Shock models globally.

The story

The GA-110 debuted in 2010, offering a large, intricate analog-digital face when digital displays were the norm for youth-oriented models. Its bold, "hyper-complex" look quickly gained worldwide popularity, leading to a vast number of color variations and high-profile collaborations. The design, created by Ryusuke Moriai, features a distinctive Y-shaped part and gear-styled hands, contributing to its mechanical feel. In 2020, a decade after its launch, the family evolved with the introduction of the GM-110 series, which features a metal-clad bezel over the traditional resin case.
